---
title: "About me"
---

Nursultan Amangeldiev is a fourth-year finance honors student at the University of Alberta specializing in Fintech.

Nursultan Amangeldiev is structured, dependable, and detail-focused and he tends to take quiet ownership: given the goal, constraints, and what "good" looks like, he breaks the work into steps and checks in only when a real decision is needed.

He applies this approach in his school work, in quantitative finance projects where the challenge is often messy real-world data. Professionally, he has also brought that same discipline into his internship at EY, where accuracy and clear documentation matter under very tight deadlines. Fluent across Kyrgyz, English and Russian, he’s comfortable working in diverse teams and navigating different communication styles.

In fast-paced case competitions he helps keep teams grounded by making the analysis defendable and making sure that the final story is clear. He also serves as VP Finance of the University of Alberta's Family Business Association.
